sources.title: Term savings
sources.text:
Term savings
NovaBank offers simulated terms of 3, 6 and 12 months at annual rates of 4.5%, 5% and 6%. Minimum deposit is 100,000 VND. Simple interest is principal times annual basis points times months divided by 120,000, rounded down to integer VND. Interest is paid when withdrawing at or after maturity. Early withdrawal returns principal with zero interest. The original funding account receives withdrawals. Confirm deposits and withdrawals with an OTP.

sources.title: Spending and statements
sources.text:
Spending and statements
Explore shows spending by category and monthly budgets. Only completed payments count; savings principal movements and credit repayments are excluded to avoid double counting. Credit purchases count when made. Statements can be exported as PDF or CSV for up to one year. Some old sample transactions predate the ledger and have no recorded balance snapshot.

sources.title: Debit and credit cards
sources.text:
Debit and credit cards
Debit purchases use the payment account balance. Simulated credit cards have a 20,000,000 VND limit; purchases increase outstanding debt and repayments reduce it. Freeze or unfreeze cards in Explore, Cards after confirming a code. Frozen cards cannot make purchases. No real card numbers, CVVs or payment networks are used.

sources.title: NovaBank transfer rules
sources.text:
NovaBank transfer rules
NovaBank is a fictional bank. Transfers use integer VND, from 1,000 to 100,000,000 VND per payment and a default 200,000,000 VND daily limit. An administrator can lower these limits and configure a fee. The reviewed draft fixes its fee. Internal transfers settle immediately after OTP confirmation. Simulated external transfers remain pending for about five seconds; account numbers ending in 0000 are rejected and refunded including fees. Never use these account IDs to send real money.
